items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: It was a trombone player on this -- Jones, he was on this job. We called him Trombone Jones

ctx.x: Did you -- were you advancing on your trumpet while you were going with --

Yes. Yes, I was. Because I was the leader, became the leader of the group, and I think we had a pretty good band, and let me think. Who else was there? Oh, that's what I meant to mention. It was a trombone player on this -- Jones, he was on this job. We called him Trombone Jones, and he was a -- he had graduated Fisk University, and he was quite a man. And he -- I remember, and his shoes -- his feet were on the ground. He turned the feet, turned up, and they had ragged clothes on, and he needed a haircut, and he…
